name: claude-faf-mcp
display_name: FAF - Persistent Project Context for AI
description: Zero-Config. Persistent project context that survives sessions, works across AI tools, and eliminates re-explaining. IANA-registered format. Core 14 tools (30 with FAF_TOOLS=all). Desktop Extension.
long_description:
Persistent project context for AI. Tell Claude what you're building, who it's for, and why it matters. 30 seconds. It never forgets.

**What it does:**
- Scores your project's AI-readiness (0-100%)
- Creates project.faf — persistent context that survives every session
- Writes CLAUDE.md from project.faf (faf-managed block; your content kept), plus AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, GEMINI.md and copilot-instructions.md on request
- Auto-detects your stack, frameworks, and architecture
- Reads the 6Ws from your README, and authors a .faf from a GitHub repo you name (faf_git clones it)

**Zero-Config. No terminal required.** Tell Claude about your project and FAF handles the rest.

**Example prompts:**
- "Set up project context for this codebase" → creates project.faf, scores AI-readiness
- "What's my AI-readiness score?" → calculates 0-100% with tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Trophy)
- "Sync my .faf to CLAUDE.md" → CLAUDE.md written from project.faf
- "Create a .faf from this GitHub repo: https://github.com/user/repo" → faf_git clones it and authors the .faf
- "Improve my score to Gold" → guided interview, adds missing context, re-scores

**IANA-registered format (application/vnd.faf+yaml). MCP Registry: one.faf/claude-faf-mcp. This extension runs the server bundled inside it; it needs Node 22 or later.**

tools.name: faf_init
tools.description: Create project.faf for a project (faf-cli detects the stack)

tools.name: faf_auto
tools.description: Fill project.faf from the repo's own files, then CLAUDE.md

tools.name: faf_go
tools.description: Guided interview for the goal and the 6Ws

tools.name: faf_sync
tools.description: Write CLAUDE.md from project.faf (+ AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, GEMINI.md, Copilot)

tools.name: faf_tri_sync
tools.description: Write faf's block into the MEMORY.md Claude Code loads for this project

tools.name: faf_setup
tools.description: Install the SessionStart hook in the project settings (preview first)

tools.name: faf_trust
tools.description: Validate project.faf and return a trust receipt for its score

tools.name: faf_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose project.faf: what is wrong and the tool that fixes it

tools.name: faf_context
tools.description: Show or set the active project; detail returns the .faf text

tools.name: faf_bench
tools.description: Benchmark AI grounding: cold vs with the .faf, with a receipt

tools.name: faf_etch
tools.description: Remember a decision across sessions (writes to the project soul, .fafm)

tools.name: faf_recall
tools.description: Recall memories from the project soul (.fafm), ranked by priority then recency

prompts.name: faf
prompts.description: Drive the project to a verified 100%: FAF sources what it can, you answer only what only you can.
prompts.text: Run the faf flow for the project at ${arguments.path}: faf_score, faf_auto, faf_go, faf_trust, then faf_sync and faf_tri_sync, and faf_setup for the session hook.

prompts.name: faf-bench
prompts.description: Run the two-pass AI-grounding benchmark (cold, then with the .faf) and report the delta with its receipt.
prompts.text: Run faf_bench for the project at ${arguments.path}: answer the questions cold, then with the .faf (faf_context detail), and grade both.
